title: MedicalData
summary: A Vue-based medical data application whose Python utility sdvTest/generate_synthetic.py synthesizes per-disease-type training tables from real patient records. It infers a SingleTableMetadata schema and fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate synthetic rows for each medical category.
